purpose: Present-executability benchmark applied uniformly to DEV; not a claim that historical 2018-2019 tariff schedule was identical.

NDX.tick_value: 1 USD per displayed tick for 1 contract
NDX.formula: 2.75 USD * volume_contracts at entry + 2.75 USD * volume_contracts at exit

XAUUSD.tick_value: 1 USD per 0.01 price movement for 1 contract
XAUUSD.round_turn_formula_usd: entry commission + exit commission using each actual fill price

spread.rule: spread cost is endogenous to side-specific fills and is never added again as a separate flat charge
spread.zero_spread: preserve observation but no artificial execution advantage beyond actual quote; existing execution guards apply

rebates.reason: D-Score/professional rebates are conditional and are not assumed

execution_profiles.CONSERVATIVE: CENTRAL plus one adverse point and one valid-quote latency step as frozen in V210 execution contract
execution_profiles.SEVERE: CENTRAL plus two adverse points and two valid-quote latency steps as frozen in V210 execution contract

stress.COST_X1_5: multiply explicit commission component only by 1.5
stress.COST_X2: multiply explicit commission component only by 2.0
